module.purpose: Defines a reactive effect system for watching query result deltas, allowing users to register handlers for enter/exit/update events on rows within query results without materializing the full result set.
module.summary: This file exports the createEffect function which creates reactive, disposable effects that monitor query results for changes. It sets up a D2 pipeline to process delta events (enter, exit, update) when rows join, leave, or modify within a watched query. The EffectPipelineRunner class manages subscriptions to source collections, runs the D2 graph for delta processing, and classifies output multiplicities into DeltaEvents. Handlers can be synchronous or async, with automatic error reporting and in-flight promise tracking for clean disposal.
module.businessContext: Enables reactive programming patterns for database query results, allowing applications to respond to data changes in real-time. Critical for UI updates, background processing, and data synchronization. Failure breaks reactive data flows and can cause missed updates or memory leaks from undisposed effects.
classes: EffectPipelineRunner (~L244-517): Internal class managing D2 pipeline for effect delta processing, subscription management, and ordered query optimization.
functions: createEffect (~L158-223): Creates a reactive effect that fires handlers when rows enter, exit, or update within a query result.
getHandlerForEvent (~L522-534): Maps DeltaEvent type to the appropriate handler function from config.
accumulateEffectChanges (~L537-562): Accumulates D2 output multiplicities into per-key effect changes tracking inserts and deletes.
classifyDelta (~L565-592): Classifies accumulated per-key changes into a DeltaEvent (enter/exit/update/undefined).
trackPromise (~L595-603): Tracks a promise in the in-flight set, automatically removing on settlement.
reportError (~L606-622): Reports an error to the onError callback or console with error normalization.

units.name: EffectPipelineRunner

detail.name: EffectPipelineRunner
detail.signature: class EffectPipelineRunner<TRow extends object, TKey extends string | number>
detail.summary: Internal class that manages a D2 incremental-view-maintenance pipeline for effect delta processing. It compiles a query IR into a D2 graph, subscribes to source collections, runs the graph on incoming changes, accumulates output multiplicity changes, and delivers classified DeltaEvent batches to a callback. It does not create or materialize collections, nor manage ordering/windowing/lazy loading of result sets.

detail.name: accumulateEffectChanges
detail.signature: function accumulateEffectChanges<T extends Record<string, any>>(changes: Map<string, T>, newChange: { alias: string; change: Partial<T> } | null): Map<string, T>
preconditions: The `changes` map must be mutable (not frozen).
postconditions: Returns a new map where each key (alias) holds the merged fields from all changes for that alias.
If `newChange` is null, the original map is returned unchanged.
Fields from `newChange.change` override existing fields with the same key in the accumulated entry.
invariants: The returned map has the same alias keys as the input map plus any new alias from `newChange`.
Order of keys in the map is preserved from the input, with new aliases appended.
edgeCases: `newChange` is null: returns the original map without mutation.
`newChange.alias` does not exist in `changes`: adds a new entry with `newChange.change` as its value.
`newChange.alias` already exists: merges `newChange.change` into the existing entry, overwriting overlapping keys.
Empty `change` object in `newChange`: no fields are added or overridden for that alias.
detail.summary: Merges a new per-alias change into an accumulator map, combining fields from previous entries and the new change while preserving alias ordering.
